223:     pub(crate) fn copy_from(&mut self, src: &[u8], max_buf_size: usize) -> usize {
224:         assert!(self.is_empty());
225: 
226:         let n = cmp::min(src.len(), max_buf_size);
227: 
228:         self.buf.extend_from_slice(&src[..n]);
229:         n
230:     }

232:     pub(crate) fn bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {
233:         &self.buf[self.pos..]
234:     }
235: 
236:     /// # Safety
237:     ///
238:     /// `rd` must not read from the buffer `read` is borrowing and must correctly
239:     /// report the length of the data written into the buffer.
240:     pub(crate) unsafe fn read_from<T: Read>(
241:         &mut self,
242:         rd: &mut T,
243:         max_buf_size: usize,
244:     ) -> io::Result<usize> {
245:         assert!(self.is_empty());
246:         self.buf.reserve(max_buf_size);
247: 
248:         let buf = &mut self.buf.spare_capacity_mut()[..max_buf_size];
249:         // SAFETY: The memory may be uninitialized, but `rd.read` will only write to the buffer.
250:         let buf = unsafe { &mut *(buf as *mut [MaybeUninit<u8>] as *mut [u8]) };
251:         let res = uninterruptibly!(rd.read(buf));
252: 
253:         if let Ok(n) = res {
254:             // SAFETY: the caller promises that `rd.read` initializes
255:             // a section of `buf` and correctly reports that length.
256:             // The `self.is_empty()` assertion verifies that `n`
257:             // equals the length of the `buf` capacity that was written
258:             // to (and that `buf` isn't being shrunk).
259:             unsafe { self.buf.set_len(n) }
260:         } else {
261:             self.buf.clear();
262:         }
263: 
264:         assert_eq!(self.pos, 0);
265: 
266:         res
267:     }
268: 
269:     pub(crate) fn write_to<T: Write>(&mut self, wr: &mut T) -> io::Result<()> {
270:         assert_eq!(self.pos, 0);
271: 
272:         // `write_all` already ignores interrupts
273:         let res = wr.write_all(&self.buf);
274:         self.buf.clear();
275:         res
276:     }
277: }

280:     impl Buf {
281:         pub(crate) fn discard_read(&mut self) -> i64 {
282:             let ret = -(self.bytes().len() as i64);
283:             self.pos = 0;
284:             self.buf.truncate(0);
285:             ret
286:         }

288:         pub(crate) fn copy_from_bufs(&mut self, bufs: &[io::IoSlice<'_>], max_buf_size: usize) -> usize {
289:             assert!(self.is_empty());

291:             let mut rem = max_buf_size;
292:             for buf in bufs {
293:                 if rem == 0 {

295:                 }
296: 
297:                 let len = buf.len().min(rem);
298:                 self.buf.extend_from_slice(&buf[..len]);
299:                 rem -= len;
300:             }
